_note: Closed registry of execution providers for NEXUS tasks. It declares PROVIDERS and the capability tiers a task may require. It deliberately ships ZERO verified models: a model catalog written from memory is stale the week it merges, and an unverified model id is a claim this repository cannot check. A model becomes usable when an observation record supplies its id, host, version, resolved limits and valid_until — the same contract agent-capabilities.py already applies to tool capabilities, and the same reason examples/nexus/host-trials.json ships empty rather than plausible.

capability_tiers._note: What a task requires of an execution target, declared as a requirement rather than a model name. Routing matches a requirement to an observed model; it never matches a requirement to a brand.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.notes: Claude Code is the one host with a recorded acceptance record; that record covers tool resolution, not model selection.

google.label: Google
google.notes: gemini-cli is already a conversion destination; conversion is not execution.

moonshot.label: Moonshot (Kimi)
moonshot.notes: kimi is already a conversion destination with a current-contract adapter test.

model_observation_contract._note: Required fields for a model entry. Missing or expired -> the model is NOT_OBSERVED and routing refuses to select it.
model_observation_contract.limits: Costs and context windows are DECLARED values from the operator's own observation, not quoted prices. They are inputs to admissibility, never a claim about a vendor's current pricing.

routing_discipline._note: Selection reuses the option-comparison discipline already in scripts/nexus-options.py.
rules: Admissibility first: a target that cannot meet a declared requirement is INADMISSIBLE and is excluded, never scored lower.
No weighted score and no ranking: report the undominated set and the dominance edges, with the evidence basis of each.
A fatal defect is never compensated by another factor.
UNKNOWN is preserved: a requirement with no observed target returns NO_ADMISSIBLE_TARGET, not a best guess.
Provider diversity is not itself a benefit; it is justified only by a requirement no single observed target satisfies, or by a measured difference under the evaluation protocol.
